svg.title: Forge UGC — Settings
svg.desc: Editable screen design matching the supplied Home SVG. Artwork and text are separate. Sample balances, items and prices are design placeholders; the game uses live player data.
svg.text: Make Forge feel right for you.
A simple prompt, or the full creative toolkit.
Turn off pulses, drifting embers and sweeps.
Darker panels, brighter text and borders.
Tab or gamepad Y opens navigation. Use arrows or the D-pad to move.
Taps, forge chimes and reward stings.
Invite a friend or join the creator community.
Scroll for every achievement and full creator group benefits.
